FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Spotless Dry Cleaning & Laundry Service, our operations focus on providing high-quality dry cleaning and laundry services in a safe and efficient manner. We offer a full range of services, including garment cleaning, pressing, and alterations, with a commitment to environmentally friendly practices. Our team is trained to handle various fabric types with care, ensuring that all garments are treated appropriately according to their specific cleaning needs. 

We prioritize safety and compliance with regulations in our operations. All our dry cleaning and laundry equipment is serviced annually by certified technicians, which not only ensures operational safety but also reduces the risk of equipment failure or accidents. Maintenance records for all equipment are meticulously kept and available for verification, demonstrating our commitment to upholding safety standards.

Our facility is designed to comply with all necessary local, state, and federal regulations regarding environmental and health standards. This includes appropriate chemical handling and disposal practices, ensuring that we operate responsibly while serving our community. Our business has been designed to avoid higher-risk operations such as industrial laundering of hazardous materials, maintaining a focus on standard garment care.

In summary, Spotless Dry Cleaning & Laundry Service is dedicated to offering exceptional service while adhering to strict safety and compliance guidelines, ensuring a reliable and trustworthy experience for our customers.

Our team frequently performs regular maintenance on our dry cleaning and laundry equipment, often relying on our in-house technicians for service rather than scheduling certified technicians for annual servicing.
